cn2.text: Adriana Vallore, captain of King Brago's guard, bursts into the dining hall to find Kaya driving a dagger into the ghostly king's neck, and her sword passes harmlessly through the assassin as Brago dies a second death.

She confronts Marchesa, who admits she paid Kaya to kill Brago after dealing with his descendants so that her own name was next in the line of succession, and when Marchesa offers her a black-rose breastplate Adriana refuses, spits in her face and leaves with Brago's sword.
Adriana then tells the citizens that Marchesa is a usurper queen, pledges her sword to the defense of the city rather than the throne, and urges the people to disobey the pretender.
She rejects Leovold's overture and stages prison breaks to win her former guards back, and months later she asks the elven explorer Selvala to help build the Republic of Paliano.
